about.headline: 8+ years building scalable products from UI architecture to cloud delivery.
paragraphs: Software Engineering Professional with 8+ years of experience specializing in Front-end Development and building scalable web applications and enterprise platforms. Proven expertise in modern front-end technologies, performance optimization, and delivering high-quality digital products.
Experienced across the full stack — from front-end architecture to APIs and cloud deployment — with a strong track record of shipping production systems used at enterprise scale.

Architected solutions including Server-Driven UI (SDUI), Plugin-Based Platforms, and Offline-First PWAs. Led mentoring, technical decisions, and integration of AI-powered capabilities into real products.
highlights: Enterprise web apps & analytics platforms
Server-Driven UI & plugin architectures

education.institution: National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra (NIT KKR)

bullets: Lead design and development of enterprise-grade web applications and automation platforms.
Architect high-performance frontend solutions including Server-Driven UI (SDUI) frameworks, real-time dashboards, and analytics platforms.
Optimize data-driven applications handling 1M+ records with virtualization, caching, and advanced UI patterns.
Collaborate with Data Science, Product, and Engineering to integrate AI/ML and intelligent automation workflows.
Provide technical leadership and mentoring through design discussions, code reviews, and best-practice adoption.
Built high-performance, data-heavy analytics dashboards for marketing intelligence.
Developed scalable frontend systems with React, Ant Design, and Redux for complex state-driven visualizations.
Optimized data transformation logic for smooth visualization of large datasets.
Engineered scalable frontend architecture for a large-scale B2B e-commerce platform.
Built reusable UI component libraries for consistency and delivery velocity.
Improved page performance and load times for high-traffic buyer–seller workflows.
Delivered full-stack features using Node.js and Angular in a fast-paced agile environment.
Built and maintained APIs and frontend modules for enterprise applications.
Resolved production issues across UI, backend, and integration layers.

achievements: Architected and delivered enterprise web applications, analytics platforms, and automation solutions.

Integrated OpenAI APIs, agent-based architectures, and ML models into production applications.

usecases.title: Enterprise Analytics at Scale
usecases.problem: Decision makers needed interactive analytics over millions of marketing and operational records without sacrificing responsiveness.
usecases.solution: Designed high-performance React dashboards with virtualization, server-side pagination, and disciplined state architecture.
usecases.outcome: Smooth exploration of 1M+ records with maintainable UI systems used across enterprise workflows.

usecases.title: Configurable Enterprise UI Platform
usecases.problem: Shipping new workflows required frequent frontend redeploys and duplicated UI logic across teams.
usecases.solution: Built a Server-Driven UI platform where JSON schemas define screens, forms, permissions, and actions.
usecases.outcome: Faster feature delivery with RBAC-aware personalization and a live studio for schema debugging.

usecases.title: B2B E-commerce Frontend Modernization
usecases.problem: High-traffic buyer–seller flows suffered from inconsistent UI and slow page loads.
usecases.solution: Engineered a scalable frontend architecture and reusable component library with performance-focused delivery.
usecases.outcome: Faster pages, consistent UX, and higher engineering velocity for product teams.

usecases.title: AI-Assisted Automation Workflows
usecases.problem: Manual operational workflows slowed teams and buried useful insights in raw data.
usecases.solution: Integrated OpenAI APIs and agent-style automation into production applications alongside existing platforms.
usecases.outcome: Automated repetitive work and unlocked faster insight loops for business stakeholders.
